adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /geo/1.0/direct?q=London&limit=1 used by the pinned credential validator, not a fabricated account endpoint. This consumes one Geocoding call from the free-plan quota.
Uses HTTPS https://api.openweathermap.org rather than the http:// examples in some OpenWeather pages.
Native category is utility rather than Location/Data: Rust CATEGORIES has neither of those buckets; admitted ops are weather and geocoding reads.
Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
q is required. Optional limit is caller-controlled (1-5) matching official Geocoding API.
Returns the raw OpenWeather location array under data rather than the pinned {locations} wrapper.
Requires lat and lon rather than the pinned exclusive q/id/zip/lat+lon selector, matching official guidance that coordinates are the most accurate location form.
Optional units and lang bind to documented query names. Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
Requires lat and lon rather than the pinned exclusive location selector. Optional units and lang bind to documented query names.
Omits the pinned json-only mode query because JSON is the official default. Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
Requires lat and lon matching official Current Air Pollution API. Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
GET /geo/1.0/reverse converts coordinates into nearby place names. Optional limit is 1-5.
GET /geo/1.0/zip resolves zip/post code plus optional country into coordinates.
GET /data/2.5/weather?q= looks up current weather by city name.
GET /data/2.5/weather?zip= looks up current weather by zip or post code.
GET /data/2.5/weather?id= looks up current weather by city ID.
GET /data/2.5/forecast?q= returns the 5-day / 3-hour forecast by city name.
GET /data/2.5/find searches current weather for matching cities.
GET /data/2.5/air_pollution/forecast returns the air-pollution forecast.
GET /data/2.5/air_pollution/history requires lat, lon, start, and end Unix timestamps.
GET /data/3.0/onecall returns current, forecast, and alert data for one location on the same api.openweathermap.org host.
GET /data/3.0/onecall/timemachine returns weather for a Unix timestamp.
GET /data/3.0/onecall/day_summary returns a daily aggregation for a YYYY-MM-DD date.
GET /data/3.0/onecall/overview returns a human-readable weather overview.
